items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Buddy Petit, Wade and Frank(?) came out here

ctx.x: Yeah, he had a little band. So did Wade. But I can't remember who was in it?
Let me see. Buddy Petit, Wade and Frank(?) came out here to join Jelly Roll at this...oh, I can't remember the name of the place right now. Then they went back to New Orleans.
